question: The Kailasha temple at Ellora near Aurangabad in Maharashtra was built by a king from the _______ Dynasty.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rashtrakuta Dynasty**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Kailasha temple at Ellora near Aurangabad** in Maharashtra was built by a king from the **Rashtrakuta Dynasty**.
 
• The temple is one of the largest rock-cut Hindu temples and is considered one of the most remarkable cave temples in India.
 
• It was commissioned by **King Krishna I** in the 8th century CE.
